scope: Synthex source APIs, temporary local registry and project; no shadcn execution, performance timing, semantic compilation, crash or device test

checks.name: install records exact original bytes and hash
recorded history distinguishes upstream change from local customization
diff previews a disjoint merge without changing any project file
update keeps customization, applies upstream change, backs up local, advances upstream baseline
repeated update preserves bytes and creates no new backup
overlapping edit blocks the entire two-component batch, in real and dry runs
explicit resolution accepts current bytes and prevents the same conflict recurring
stale transaction expectation refuses overwrite without project mutation
